symptom: songbird federation returns empty, eastGate port 7700 not binding
root_cause_chain: sporeGate had TWO songbird services: membrane-songbird (naked, no config) + songbird-gateway (fully configured but duplicate)
eastGate had THREE songbird spawners: songbird-federation + membrane-nucleus@songbird + Cursor IDE (all competing for sockets)
Both membrane-songbird and songbird-federation were missing identity config (FAMILY_ID, NODE_ID, PEERS)
The cyst (songbird-gateway) HAD the correct config — it was the FIX ATTEMPT, not the problem
eastGate songbird hung on JWT provisioning: biomeos-neural.sock does not implement crypto.generate.jwt_secret, hangs instead of erroring
beardog.sock returns proper -32601 error, triggering fallback JWT generation

sporegate: Created drop-in mesh-identity.conf for membrane-songbird.service with config transplanted FROM the cyst
eastgate: Added --security-socket to service unit pointing at beardog.sock
Set SECURITY_PROVIDER_SOCKET=beardog.sock to bypass biomeos-neural JWT hang

diagnostic_law: The cyst is the VICTIM. The cyst (songbird-gateway) had the correct config. The running service was the one that was broken. The wall we built around the cyst was the diagnostic instrument — it told us what the real service was missing.
signal_beacon_pairs: SIGNAL: empty federation response → BEACON: cyst config had all the missing env vars
SIGNAL: port 7700 not binding → BEACON: JWT provisioning hanging on biomeos-neural.sock
SIGNAL: fd exhaustion (os error 24) → BEACON: nucleus@songbird spawning duplicate naked processes
SIGNAL: beardog returns -32601 → BEACON: fallback JWT works, the provider matters
